text: Hello, I'm so sorry to be messaging at this hour, I know you must be very busy. I'm looking after my granddaughter who is 5, and she has a temperature, it was 38.2 when I checked it about half an hour ago, I think the thermometer is right but it's an old one. She just won't settle to sleep tonight, keeps getting up and coming to find me, but otherwise she seems fine in herself, chatting away. I want to say there's been no fit or shaking or anything like that, I've been keeping an eye and she hasn't jerked or anything. I'm probably just being a silly old worrier but her mum and dad are away and I'd never forgive myself if I didn't ask. Is there anything I should be doing, or is it alright to just keep her comfy and let her drop off when she's ready? Thank you so much and sorry again
